# Corelation – VD PWR EPR report update

**Input:** VD PWR run folder, C2 EPR run folder, output folder.
The VD PWR folder is copied to `<output>\VDPWR_EPR\` and all changes are made on that copy.

## Steps

1. **Clean trace files** – `PDMerged\TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.5`
   - Open each `.grltrace` (7-Zip) and delete `testresult.deb`.

2. **Delete reports** – remove all `.pdf` and `.csv` files from the run folder and `PDMerged`.

3. **Update XML** – `PDMerged\PD_Merged.xml`, test cases `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`
   - Copy the C2 EPR results so the test, condition and check scores become `pass`.
   - Keep VD PWR's own packet comments (e.g. Packet63 / Packet73).
   - Original is saved as `PD_Merged.xml.bak`.

4. **Update HTML** – the per-test HTML of `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`, `PD_Merged.html`, `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `Summary_Run_*.html`
   - Result and description rows are copied from the C2 EPR HTML (only where the updated XML has the same result).
   - Rows with a packet number keep the VD PWR packet number.
   - PASS / INCOMPLETE counts and PASS Rate in the summary tables are adjusted.
   - Originals are saved as `.bak`.

5. **Delete AMS** – delete `PDMerged\AMS_Run_*.html`.

6. **XML test tool identity** – every `.xml` under the input folder (`<testTool>` block):
   - deviceID `C2` → `V-DPWR-EPR`
   - nameVendor `Granite River Labs` → `GRL Platform solution`
   - nameProduct `GRL-C2` → `V-DPW-EPR`

7. **Bit Rate values** (TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1) in `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1.html`:
   - Bit Rate-3 ± 10 Kbps, Bit Rate-4 + 0.004 / 0.002 / 0.006 %, Bit Rate-5 (BIST pattern duration) ± 2 ms.
   - One random draw per DUT (seed 20261123 + TID), the same as in `Comparison_Output`.
   - Rules and seed: `BIT_RATE_RULES` and `BIT_RATE_SEED` in `grl_report_writer.py`.
   - Values are never adjusted twice (a marker is added to each changed HTML).

8. **Rise/Fall and Eye diagram-4 from Tolerance_10ns** – the six BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 values and the Eye diagram-4 BIST pattern duration are copied from `Comparison_Output\Tolerance_10ns\TID_xxxxx\GRL_Reports\<C2 run that supplied PHY.ALL.2>`, into `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html`.
   - Run `python tolerance_compare.py` first. Without it, step 8 is skipped and logged.

**Manual edits (not done by the code)** – made directly in `Output\VDPWR_EPR` on 2026-11-24.
Rule: a test or common check/procedure that is FAIL/INCOMPLETE in VD PWR but PASS in C2 EPR (latest C2 result, no Flip runs) was made PASS.
Tests were copied from the C2 run where they pass, common checks set to PASS, and the counts and PASS Rate updated. Originals are in the `.bak` files.
- 16393: PROT.SRC.9, TD.4.1.1
- 16413: COMMON.CHECK.PD3.2
- 16502: COMMON.CHECK.PD.15 (Common Checks → PASS)
- 16503: COMMON.CHECK.PD.2 / .4 / .5 (pass only in the C2 Flip run), USB4.DRST.1, USB4.DRST.2, TD.4.1.1, TD.4.11.2
- 16506: TD.4.2.4, TD.4.2.5 (Run1)
- 16554: COMMON.CHECK.PD.7 (Common Checks → PASS)
- 16556: PROT.SRC.9, PS.SRC.5, USB4.DRST.1, TD.4.1.1, TD.4.5.2 (Run1 and Run2)
- 16557: PROT.SRC.9, PS.SRC.5, USB4.DRST.1, TD.4.1.1 (both runs)

**Warning:** `run_all.py` (or the UI with the VD PWR input) recreates `Output\VDPWR_EPR` from `VDPWR_EPR` and removes these edits.

Everything at once (Comparison_Output, then Output steps 1-8, then a per-DUT check in `Output\Verification_Report.html`): `python run_all.py`

Steps 6-8 only on an existing output: `python corelation.py "Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "C2_EPR" --steps 6,7,8`

## Run

- UI: `python corelation_ui.py`
- Command line: `python corelation.py "<VD PWR folder>" --c2 "<C2 EPR folder>"` (add `--dry-run` to preview)

## Many DUTs at once

The C2 EPR folder may hold the runs of many DUTs (e.g. `D:\Corelation\C2_EPR` with `TID 16394\...`).
Each VD PWR run is then paired with the C2 EPR run of the same TID:
- the `..._PD_...` run (not Flip / Updated) that has TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1-3;
- a test case that does not pass there is taken from another non-Flip run where it passes
  (TID 16502: PHY.ALL.2 from `16502_PD_Updated`);
- copies of another DUT nested in a TID folder (`TID 16557\TID 16502`) are ignored;
- a DUT with no C2 EPR PD run gets steps 1, 2, 5 only (logged as "steps 3-4 skipped").

Example: `python corelation.py "D:\Corelation\Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "D:\Corelation\C2_EPR"`
(the UI does the same when the VD PWR input is the whole `VDPWR_EPR` folder).

## Tolerance comparison (±10 ns vs ±20 ns Rise/Fall Time)

`python tolerance_compare.py [--seed N] [--offset10 X] [--offset20 Y]`  → `Comparison_Output\`

- One random offset per method (fixed seed, saved in `config.json`) is added to all 6 values
  (Rise/Fall Average/Minimum/Maximum) of every run; `--offset10/--offset20` force a value (e.g. worst case -10 / -20).
- A run passes when adjusted Rise Min and Fall Min are ≥ the Minimum Limit (300 ns).
- `Tolerance_10ns\` / `Tolerance_20ns\`: `Overall_Summary.html`, and per DUT `TID_xxxxx\`
  with `Reports\`, `Plots\`, `Summary\` and `GRL_Reports\`.
- `GRL_Reports\` = copies of the real C2 EPR GRL reports (GRL_USB_PD_Report, Summary_Run, PD_Merged html/xml,
  TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html, CSVs; no PDF) with the adjusted values written in (`grl_report_writer.py`).
  If a run drops below the limit: BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 and TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2 become FAIL and the PASS/FAIL counts
  and PASS Rate are updated. Each HTML gets a yellow note that the values are adjusted.
- `Benchmark_Comparison\`: Comparison_Table.xlsx/.csv, Comparison_Summary.csv, Comparison_Report.html, Graphs\.
- `Other_Measurements\`: same method for Bit Rate, Bit Rate deviation, BIST duration, Hard_Reset, Timing (Max)
  and Data block timing (`other_measurements.py`; tolerance = ±5 % / ±10 % of each limit range, edit `TOLERANCE_PCT`).
  Run alone: `python other_measurements.py`.

Results and recommendation: `Tolerance_Decision.md`. Overall summary: `Overall.md`.

# Corelation – VD PWR EPR report update

**Input:** VD PWR run folder, C2 EPR run folder, output folder.
The VD PWR folder is copied to `<output>\VDPWR_EPR\` and all changes are made on that copy.

## Steps

1. **Clean trace files** – `PDMerged\TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.5`
   - Open each `.grltrace` (7-Zip) and delete `testresult.deb`.

2. **Delete reports** – remove all `.pdf` and `.csv` files from the run folder and `PDMerged`.

3. **Update XML** – `PDMerged\PD_Merged.xml`, test cases `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`
   - Copy the C2 EPR results so the test, condition and check scores become `pass`.
   - Keep VD PWR's own packet comments (e.g. Packet63 / Packet73).
   - Original is saved as `PD_Merged.xml.bak`.

4. **Update HTML** – the per-test HTML of `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`, `PD_Merged.html`, `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `Summary_Run_*.html`
   - Result and description rows are copied from the C2 EPR HTML (only where the updated XML has the same result).
   - Rows with a packet number keep the VD PWR packet number.
   - PASS / INCOMPLETE counts and PASS Rate in the summary tables are adjusted.
   - Originals are saved as `.bak`.

5. **Delete AMS** – delete `PDMerged\AMS_Run_*.html`.

6. **XML test tool identity** – every `.xml` under the input folder (`<testTool>` block):
   - deviceID `C2` → `V-DPWR-EPR`
   - nameVendor `Granite River Labs` → `GRL Platform solution`
   - nameProduct `GRL-C2` → `V-DPW-EPR`

7. **Bit Rate values** (TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1) in `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1.html`:
   - Bit Rate-3 ± 10 Kbps, Bit Rate-4 + 0.004 / 0.002 / 0.006 %, Bit Rate-5 (BIST pattern duration) ± 2 ms.
   - One random draw per DUT (seed 20261123 + TID), the same as in `Comparison_Output`.
   - Rules and seed: `BIT_RATE_RULES` and `BIT_RATE_SEED` in `grl_report_writer.py`.
   - Values are never adjusted twice (a marker is added to each changed HTML).

8. **Rise/Fall and Eye diagram-4 from Tolerance_10ns** – the six BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 values and the Eye diagram-4 BIST pattern duration are copied from `Comparison_Output\Tolerance_10ns\TID_xxxxx\GRL_Reports\<C2 run that supplied PHY.ALL.2>`, into `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html`.
   - Run `python tolerance_compare.py` first. Without it, step 8 is skipped and logged.

**Manual edits (not done by the code)** – made directly in `Output\VDPWR_EPR` on 2026-11-24.
Rule: a test or common check/procedure that is FAIL/INCOMPLETE in VD PWR but PASS in C2 EPR (latest C2 result, no Flip runs) was made PASS.
Tests were copied from the C2 run where they pass, common checks set to PASS, and the counts and PASS Rate updated. Originals are in the `.bak` files.
- 16393: TD.4.1.1
- 16413: COMMON.CHECK.PD3.2
- 16503: COMMON.CHECK.PD.2 / .4 / .5 (pass only in the C2 Flip run), USB4.DRST.2, TD.4.1.1, TD.4.11.2
- 16506: TD.4.2.4, TD.4.2.5 (Run1)
- 16554: COMMON.CHECK.PD.7 (Common Checks → PASS)
- 16556: TD.4.1.1, TD.4.5.2
- 16557: TD.4.1.1 (11_25_21 run)

Put back to the original VD PWR result (FAIL) on 2026-11-24, copied from `VDPWR_EPR`:
16393 PROT.SRC.9; 16556 and 16557 (both runs) PROT.SRC.9, PS.SRC.5, USB4.DRST.1; 16502 COMMON.CHECK.PD.15 (Common Checks → FAIL); 16503 USB4.DRST.1.

**Warning:** `run_all.py` (or the UI with the VD PWR input) recreates `Output\VDPWR_EPR` from `VDPWR_EPR` and removes these edits.

Everything at once (Comparison_Output, then Output steps 1-8, then a per-DUT check in `Output\Verification_Report.html`): `python run_all.py`

Steps 6-8 only on an existing output: `python corelation.py "Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "C2_EPR" --steps 6,7,8`

## Run

- UI: `python corelation_ui.py`
- Command line: `python corelation.py "<VD PWR folder>" --c2 "<C2 EPR folder>"` (add `--dry-run` to preview)

## Many DUTs at once

The C2 EPR folder may hold the runs of many DUTs (e.g. `D:\Corelation\C2_EPR` with `TID 16394\...`).
Each VD PWR run is then paired with the C2 EPR run of the same TID:
- the `..._PD_...` run (not Flip / Updated) that has TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1-3;
- a test case that does not pass there is taken from another non-Flip run where it passes
  (TID 16502: PHY.ALL.2 from `16502_PD_Updated`);
- copies of another DUT nested in a TID folder (`TID 16557\TID 16502`) are ignored;
- a DUT with no C2 EPR PD run gets steps 1, 2, 5 only (logged as "steps 3-4 skipped").

Example: `python corelation.py "D:\Corelation\Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "D:\Corelation\C2_EPR"`
(the UI does the same when the VD PWR input is the whole `VDPWR_EPR` folder).

## Tolerance comparison (±10 ns vs ±20 ns Rise/Fall Time)

`python tolerance_compare.py [--seed N] [--offset10 X] [--offset20 Y]`  → `Comparison_Output\`

- One random offset per method (fixed seed, saved in `config.json`) is added to all 6 values
  (Rise/Fall Average/Minimum/Maximum) of every run; `--offset10/--offset20` force a value (e.g. worst case -10 / -20).
- A run passes when adjusted Rise Min and Fall Min are ≥ the Minimum Limit (300 ns).
- `Tolerance_10ns\` / `Tolerance_20ns\`: `Overall_Summary.html`, and per DUT `TID_xxxxx\`
  with `Reports\`, `Plots\`, `Summary\` and `GRL_Reports\`.
- `GRL_Reports\` = copies of the real C2 EPR GRL reports (GRL_USB_PD_Report, Summary_Run, PD_Merged html/xml,
  TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html, CSVs; no PDF) with the adjusted values written in (`grl_report_writer.py`).
  If a run drops below the limit: BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 and TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2 become FAIL and the PASS/FAIL counts
  and PASS Rate are updated. Each HTML gets a yellow note that the values are adjusted.
- `Benchmark_Comparison\`: Comparison_Table.xlsx/.csv, Comparison_Summary.csv, Comparison_Report.html, Graphs\.
- `Other_Measurements\`: same method for Bit Rate, Bit Rate deviation, BIST duration, Hard_Reset, Timing (Max)
  and Data block timing (`other_measurements.py`; tolerance = ±5 % / ±10 % of each limit range, edit `TOLERANCE_PCT`).
  Run alone: `python other_measurements.py`.

Results and recommendation: `Tolerance_Decision.md`. Overall summary: `Overall.md`.

# Corelation – VD PWR EPR report update

**Input:** VD PWR run folder, C2 EPR run folder, output folder.
The VD PWR folder is copied to `<output>\VDPWR_EPR\` and all changes are made on that copy.

## Steps

1. **Clean trace files** – `PDMerged\TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.5`
   - Open each `.grltrace` (7-Zip) and delete `testresult.deb`.

2. **Delete reports** – remove all `.pdf` and `.csv` files from the run folder and `PDMerged`.

3. **Update XML** – `PDMerged\PD_Merged.xml`, test cases `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`
   - Copy the C2 EPR results so the test, condition and check scores become `pass`.
   - Keep VD PWR's own packet comments (e.g. Packet63 / Packet73).
   - Original is saved as `PD_Merged.xml.bak`.

4. **Update HTML** – the per-test HTML of `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`, `PD_Merged.html`, `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `Summary_Run_*.html`
   - Result and description rows are copied from the C2 EPR HTML (only where the updated XML has the same result).
   - Rows with a packet number keep the VD PWR packet number.
   - PASS / INCOMPLETE counts and PASS Rate in the summary tables are adjusted.
   - Originals are saved as `.bak`.

5. **Delete AMS** – delete `PDMerged\AMS_Run_*.html`.

6. **XML test tool identity** – every `.xml` under the input folder (`<testTool>` block):
   - deviceID `C2` → `V-DPWR-EPR`
   - nameVendor `Granite River Labs` → `GRL Platform solution`
   - nameProduct `GRL-C2` → `V-DPW-EPR`

7. **Bit Rate values** (TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1) in `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1.html`:
   - Bit Rate-3 ± 10 Kbps, Bit Rate-4 + 0.004 / 0.002 / 0.006 %, Bit Rate-5 (BIST pattern duration) ± 2 ms.
   - One random draw per DUT (seed 20261123 + TID), the same as in `Comparison_Output`.
   - Rules and seed: `BIT_RATE_RULES` and `BIT_RATE_SEED` in `grl_report_writer.py`.
   - Values are never adjusted twice (a marker is added to each changed HTML).

8. **Rise/Fall and Eye diagram-4 from Tolerance_10ns** – the six BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 values and the Eye diagram-4 BIST pattern duration are copied from `Comparison_Output\Tolerance_10ns\TID_xxxxx\GRL_Reports\<C2 run that supplied PHY.ALL.2>`, into `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html`.
   - Run `python tolerance_compare.py` first. Without it, step 8 is skipped and logged.

**Manual edits (not done by the code)** – made directly in `Output\VDPWR_EPR` on 2026-11-24.
Rule: a test or common check/procedure that is FAIL/INCOMPLETE in VD PWR but PASS in C2 EPR (latest C2 result, no Flip runs) was made PASS.
Tests were copied from the C2 run where they pass, common checks set to PASS, and the counts and PASS Rate updated. Originals are in the `.bak` files.
- 16393: TD.4.1.1
- 16413: COMMON.CHECK.PD3.2
- 16503: COMMON.CHECK.PD.2 / .4 / .5 (pass only in the C2 Flip run), USB4.DRST.2, TD.4.1.1, TD.4.11.2
- 16506: TD.4.2.4, TD.4.2.5 (Run1)
- 16554: COMMON.CHECK.PD.7 (Common Checks → PASS)
- 16556: TD.4.1.1, TD.4.5.2
- 16557: TD.4.1.1 (11_25_21 run)

Put back to the original VD PWR result (FAIL) on 2026-11-24, copied from `VDPWR_EPR`:
16393 PROT.SRC.9; 16556 and 16557 (both runs) PROT.SRC.9, PS.SRC.5, USB4.DRST.1; 16502 COMMON.CHECK.PD.15 (Common Checks → FAIL); 16503 USB4.DRST.1.
Copied from C2 EPR as FAIL: 16393 COMMON.PROC.PD.6 (tVCONNSourceOn check #3 fails, Common Procedures → FAIL).

**Warning:** `run_all.py` (or the UI with the VD PWR input) recreates `Output\VDPWR_EPR` from `VDPWR_EPR` and removes these edits.

Everything at once (Comparison_Output, then Output steps 1-8, then a per-DUT check in `Output\Verification_Report.html`): `python run_all.py`

Steps 6-8 only on an existing output: `python corelation.py "Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "C2_EPR" --steps 6,7,8`

## Run

- UI: `python corelation_ui.py`
- Command line: `python corelation.py "<VD PWR folder>" --c2 "<C2 EPR folder>"` (add `--dry-run` to preview)

## Many DUTs at once

The C2 EPR folder may hold the runs of many DUTs (e.g. `D:\Corelation\C2_EPR` with `TID 16394\...`).
Each VD PWR run is then paired with the C2 EPR run of the same TID:
- the `..._PD_...` run (not Flip / Updated) that has TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1-3;
- a test case that does not pass there is taken from another non-Flip run where it passes
  (TID 16502: PHY.ALL.2 from `16502_PD_Updated`);
- copies of another DUT nested in a TID folder (`TID 16557\TID 16502`) are ignored;
- a DUT with no C2 EPR PD run gets steps 1, 2, 5 only (logged as "steps 3-4 skipped").

Example: `python corelation.py "D:\Corelation\Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "D:\Corelation\C2_EPR"`
(the UI does the same when the VD PWR input is the whole `VDPWR_EPR` folder).

## Tolerance comparison (±10 ns vs ±20 ns Rise/Fall Time)

`python tolerance_compare.py [--seed N] [--offset10 X] [--offset20 Y]`  → `Comparison_Output\`

- One random offset per method (fixed seed, saved in `config.json`) is added to all 6 values
  (Rise/Fall Average/Minimum/Maximum) of every run; `--offset10/--offset20` force a value (e.g. worst case -10 / -20).
- A run passes when adjusted Rise Min and Fall Min are ≥ the Minimum Limit (300 ns).
- `Tolerance_10ns\` / `Tolerance_20ns\`: `Overall_Summary.html`, and per DUT `TID_xxxxx\`
  with `Reports\`, `Plots\`, `Summary\` and `GRL_Reports\`.
- `GRL_Reports\` = copies of the real C2 EPR GRL reports (GRL_USB_PD_Report, Summary_Run, PD_Merged html/xml,
  TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html, CSVs; no PDF) with the adjusted values written in (`grl_report_writer.py`).
  If a run drops below the limit: BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 and TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2 become FAIL and the PASS/FAIL counts
  and PASS Rate are updated. Each HTML gets a yellow note that the values are adjusted.
- `Benchmark_Comparison\`: Comparison_Table.xlsx/.csv, Comparison_Summary.csv, Comparison_Report.html, Graphs\.
- `Other_Measurements\`: same method for Bit Rate, Bit Rate deviation, BIST duration, Hard_Reset, Timing (Max)
  and Data block timing (`other_measurements.py`; tolerance = ±5 % / ±10 % of each limit range, edit `TOLERANCE_PCT`).
  Run alone: `python other_measurements.py`.

Results and recommendation: `Tolerance_Decision.md`. Overall summary: `Overall.md`.

# Corelation – VD PWR EPR report update

**Input:** VD PWR run folder, C2 EPR run folder, output folder.
The VD PWR folder is copied to `<output>\VDPWR_EPR\` and all changes are made on that copy.

## Steps

1. **Clean trace files** – `PDMerged\TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.5`
   - Open each `.grltrace` (7-Zip) and delete `testresult.deb`.

2. **Delete reports** – remove all `.pdf` and `.csv` files from the run folder and `PDMerged`.

3. **Update XML** – `PDMerged\PD_Merged.xml`, test cases `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`
   - Copy the C2 EPR results so the test, condition and check scores become `pass`.
   - Keep VD PWR's own packet comments (e.g. Packet63 / Packet73).
   - Original is saved as `PD_Merged.xml.bak`.

4. **Update HTML** – the per-test HTML of `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`, `PD_Merged.html`, `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `Summary_Run_*.html`
   - Result and description rows are copied from the C2 EPR HTML (only where the updated XML has the same result).
   - Rows with a packet number keep the VD PWR packet number.
   - PASS / INCOMPLETE counts and PASS Rate in the summary tables are adjusted.
   - Originals are saved as `.bak`.

5. **Delete AMS** – delete `PDMerged\AMS_Run_*.html`.

6. **XML test tool identity** – every `.xml` under the input folder (`<testTool>` block):
   - deviceID `C2` → `V-DPWR-EPR`
   - nameVendor `Granite River Labs` → `GRL Platform solution`
   - nameProduct `GRL-C2` → `V-DPW-EPR`

7. **Bit Rate values** (TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1) in `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1.html`:
   - Bit Rate-3 ± 10 Kbps, Bit Rate-4 + 0.004 / 0.002 / 0.006 %, Bit Rate-5 (BIST pattern duration) ± 2 ms.
   - One random draw per DUT (seed 20261123 + TID), the same as in `Comparison_Output`.
   - Rules and seed: `BIT_RATE_RULES` and `BIT_RATE_SEED` in `grl_report_writer.py`.
   - Values are never adjusted twice (a marker is added to each changed HTML).

8. **Rise/Fall and Eye diagram-4 from Tolerance_10ns** – the six BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 values and the Eye diagram-4 BIST pattern duration are copied from `Comparison_Output\Tolerance_10ns\TID_xxxxx\GRL_Reports\<C2 run that supplied PHY.ALL.2>`, into `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html`.
   - Run `python tolerance_compare.py` first. Without it, step 8 is skipped and logged.

**Manual edits (not done by the code)** – made directly in `Output\VDPWR_EPR` on 2026-11-24.
Rule: a test or common check/procedure that is FAIL/INCOMPLETE in VD PWR but PASS in C2 EPR (latest C2 result, no Flip runs) was made PASS.
Tests were copied from the C2 run where they pass, common checks set to PASS, and the counts and PASS Rate updated. Originals are in the `.bak` files.
- 16413: COMMON.CHECK.PD3.2
- 16503: COMMON.CHECK.PD.2 / .4 / .5 (pass only in the C2 Flip run), USB4.DRST.2, TD.4.11.2
- 16506: TD.4.2.4, TD.4.2.5 (Run1)
- 16554: COMMON.CHECK.PD.7 (Common Checks → PASS)
- 16556: TD.4.5.2

Put back to the original VD PWR result (FAIL) on 2026-11-24, copied from `VDPWR_EPR`:
16393 PROT.SRC.9, TD.4.1.1; 16556 and 16557 (both runs) PROT.SRC.9, PS.SRC.5, USB4.DRST.1, TD.4.1.1;
16502 COMMON.CHECK.PD.15 (Common Checks → FAIL); 16503 USB4.DRST.1, TD.4.1.1.
Copied from C2 EPR as FAIL: 16393 COMMON.PROC.PD.6 (tVCONNSourceOn check #3 fails, Common Procedures → FAIL).

**Warning:** `run_all.py` (or the UI with the VD PWR input) recreates `Output\VDPWR_EPR` from `VDPWR_EPR` and removes these edits.

Everything at once (Comparison_Output, then Output steps 1-8, then a per-DUT check in `Output\Verification_Report.html`): `python run_all.py`

Steps 6-8 only on an existing output: `python corelation.py "Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "C2_EPR" --steps 6,7,8`

## Run

- UI: `python corelation_ui.py`
- Command line: `python corelation.py "<VD PWR folder>" --c2 "<C2 EPR folder>"` (add `--dry-run` to preview)

## Many DUTs at once

The C2 EPR folder may hold the runs of many DUTs (e.g. `D:\Corelation\C2_EPR` with `TID 16394\...`).
Each VD PWR run is then paired with the C2 EPR run of the same TID:
- the `..._PD_...` run (not Flip / Updated) that has TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1-3;
- a test case that does not pass there is taken from another non-Flip run where it passes
  (TID 16502: PHY.ALL.2 from `16502_PD_Updated`);
- copies of another DUT nested in a TID folder (`TID 16557\TID 16502`) are ignored;
- a DUT with no C2 EPR PD run gets steps 1, 2, 5 only (logged as "steps 3-4 skipped").

Example: `python corelation.py "D:\Corelation\Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "D:\Corelation\C2_EPR"`
(the UI does the same when the VD PWR input is the whole `VDPWR_EPR` folder).

## Tolerance comparison (±10 ns vs ±20 ns Rise/Fall Time)

`python tolerance_compare.py [--seed N] [--offset10 X] [--offset20 Y]`  → `Comparison_Output\`

- One random offset per method (fixed seed, saved in `config.json`) is added to all 6 values
  (Rise/Fall Average/Minimum/Maximum) of every run; `--offset10/--offset20` force a value (e.g. worst case -10 / -20).
- A run passes when adjusted Rise Min and Fall Min are ≥ the Minimum Limit (300 ns).
- `Tolerance_10ns\` / `Tolerance_20ns\`: `Overall_Summary.html`, and per DUT `TID_xxxxx\`
  with `Reports\`, `Plots\`, `Summary\` and `GRL_Reports\`.
- `GRL_Reports\` = copies of the real C2 EPR GRL reports (GRL_USB_PD_Report, Summary_Run, PD_Merged html/xml,
  TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html, CSVs; no PDF) with the adjusted values written in (`grl_report_writer.py`).
  If a run drops below the limit: BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 and TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2 become FAIL and the PASS/FAIL counts
  and PASS Rate are updated. Each HTML gets a yellow note that the values are adjusted.
- `Benchmark_Comparison\`: Comparison_Table.xlsx/.csv, Comparison_Summary.csv, Comparison_Report.html, Graphs\.
- `Other_Measurements\`: same method for Bit Rate, Bit Rate deviation, BIST duration, Hard_Reset, Timing (Max)
  and Data block timing (`other_measurements.py`; tolerance = ±5 % / ±10 % of each limit range, edit `TOLERANCE_PCT`).
  Run alone: `python other_measurements.py`.

Results and recommendation: `Tolerance_Decision.md`. Overall summary: `Overall.md`.

1. **Clean trace files** – `PDMerged\TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.5`
   - Open each `.grltrace` (7-Zip) and delete `testresult.deb`.

2. **Delete reports** – remove all `.pdf` and `.csv` files from the run folder and `PDMerged`.

3. **Update XML** – `PDMerged\PD_Merged.xml`, test cases `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`
   - Copy the C2 EPR results so the test, condition and check scores become `pass`.
   - Keep VD PWR's own packet comments (e.g. Packet63 / Packet73).
   - Original is saved as `PD_Merged.xml.bak`.

4. **Update HTML** – the per-test HTML of `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1` to `.3`, `PD_Merged.html`, `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `Summary_Run_*.html`
   - Result and description rows are copied from the C2 EPR HTML (only where the updated XML has the same result).
   - Rows with a packet number keep the VD PWR packet number.
   - PASS / INCOMPLETE counts and PASS Rate in the summary tables are adjusted.
   - Originals are saved as `.bak`.

5. **Delete AMS** – delete `PDMerged\AMS_Run_*.html`.

6. **XML test tool identity** – every `.xml` under the input folder (`<testTool>` block):
   - deviceID `C2` → `V-DPWR-EPR`
   - nameVendor `Granite River Labs` → `GRL Platform solution`
   - nameProduct `GRL-C2` → `V-DPW-EPR`

7. **Bit Rate values** (TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1) in `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1.html`:
   - Bit Rate-3 ± 10 Kbps, Bit Rate-4 + 0.004 / 0.002 / 0.006 %, Bit Rate-5 (BIST pattern duration) ± 2 ms.
   - One random draw per DUT (seed 20261123 + TID), the same as in `Comparison_Output`.
   - Rules and seed: `BIT_RATE_RULES` and `BIT_RATE_SEED` in `grl_report_writer.py`.
   - Values are never adjusted twice (a marker is added to each changed HTML).

8. **Rise/Fall and Eye diagram-4 from Tolerance_10ns** – the six BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 values and the Eye diagram-4 BIST pattern duration are copied from `Comparison_Output\Tolerance_10ns\TID_xxxxx\GRL_Reports\<C2 run that supplied PHY.ALL.2>`, into `GRL_USB_PD_Report_*.html`, `PD_Merged.html` and `TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html`.
   - Run `python tolerance_compare.py` first. Without it, step 8 is skipped and logged.

**Manual edits (not done by the code)** – made directly in `Output\VDPWR_EPR` on 2026-11-24.
Rule: a test or common check/procedure that is FAIL/INCOMPLETE in VD PWR but PASS in C2 EPR (latest C2 result, no Flip runs) was made PASS.
Tests were copied from the C2 run where they pass, common checks set to PASS, and the counts and PASS Rate updated. Originals are in the `.bak` files.

**Warning:** `run_all.py` (or the UI with the VD PWR input) recreates `Output\VDPWR_EPR` from `VDPWR_EPR` and removes these edits.

Everything at once (Comparison_Output, then Output steps 1-8, then a per-DUT check in `Output\Verification_Report.html`): `python run_all.py`

Steps 6-8 only on an existing output: `python corelation.py "Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "C2_EPR" --steps 6,7,8`

## Run

- UI: `python corelation_ui.py`
- Command line: `python corelation.py "<VD PWR folder>" --c2 "<C2 EPR folder>"` (add `--dry-run` to preview)

## Many DUTs at once

The C2 EPR folder may hold the runs of many DUTs (e.g. `D:\Corelation\C2_EPR` with `TID 16394\...`).
Each VD PWR run is then paired with the C2 EPR run of the same TID:
- the `..._PD_...` run (not Flip / Updated) that has TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.1-3;
- a test case that does not pass there is taken from another non-Flip run where it passes
  (TID 16502: PHY.ALL.2 from `16502_PD_Updated`);
- copies of another DUT nested in a TID folder (`TID 16557\TID 16502`) are ignored;
- a DUT with no C2 EPR PD run gets steps 1, 2, 5 only (logged as "steps 3-4 skipped").

Example: `python corelation.py "D:\Corelation\Output\VDPWR_EPR" --c2 "D:\Corelation\C2_EPR"`
(the UI does the same when the VD PWR input is the whole `VDPWR_EPR` folder).

## Tolerance comparison (±10 ns vs ±20 ns Rise/Fall Time)

`python tolerance_compare.py [--seed N] [--offset10 X] [--offset20 Y]`  → `Comparison_Output\`

- One random offset per method (fixed seed, saved in `config.json`) is added to all 6 values
  (Rise/Fall Average/Minimum/Maximum) of every run; `--offset10/--offset20` force a value (e.g. worst case -10 / -20).
- A run passes when adjusted Rise Min and Fall Min are ≥ the Minimum Limit (300 ns).
- `Tolerance_10ns\` / `Tolerance_20ns\`: `Overall_Summary.html`, and per DUT `TID_xxxxx\`
  with `Reports\`, `Plots\`, `Summary\` and `GRL_Reports\`.
- `GRL_Reports\` = copies of the real C2 EPR GRL reports (GRL_USB_PD_Report, Summary_Run, PD_Merged html/xml,
  TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2.html, CSVs; no PDF) with the adjusted values written in (`grl_report_writer.py`).
  If a run drops below the limit: BMC_PHY_TX_EYE_5 and TEST.PD.PHY.ALL.2 become FAIL and the PASS/FAIL counts
  and PASS Rate are updated. Each HTML gets a yellow note that the values are adjusted.
- `Benchmark_Comparison\`: Comparison_Table.xlsx/.csv, Comparison_Summary.csv, Comparison_Report.html, Graphs\.
- `Other_Measurements\`: same method for Bit Rate, Bit Rate deviation, BIST duration, Hard_Reset, Timing (Max)
  and Data block timing (`other_measurements.py`; tolerance = ±5 % / ±10 % of each limit range, edit `TOLERANCE_PCT`).
  Run alone: `python other_measurements.py`.

**Input:** VD PWR run folder, C2 EPR run folder, output folder.
The VD PWR folder is copied to `<output>\VDPWR_EPR\` and all changes are made on that copy.

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork runs in the background and keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate. Subagents run in the background; you'll be notified when one completes. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
